A = histogram('gen_ai.client.token.usage', filter=filter('gen_ai.framework', 'llamaindex')).sum(by=['service.name'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.name']).publish(label='A')

C = histogram('gen_ai.client.token.usage', filter=filter('gen_ai.token.type', 'output') and filter('gen_ai.framework', 'llamaindex')).sum(by=['service.name'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.name']).publish(label='C')
D = histogram('gen_ai.client.operation.duration', filter=filter('gen_ai.framework', 'llamaindex')).count(by=['service.name'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.name']).publish(label='D')
E = histogram('gen_ai.client.operation.duration', filter=filter('gen_ai.framework', 'llamaindex')).mean(by=['service.name'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).mean(by=['service.name']).publish(label='E')
F = histogram('gen_ai.client.operation.time_to_first_chunk', filter=filter('gen_ai.framework', 'llamaindex')).mean(by=['service.name'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).mean(by=['service.name']).mean(by=['service.name']).publish(label='F')
